name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 4
content: The latest tests have shown promising results. We have found that a combination of honey and the weird blue fluid can effectively contain the parasite into the vaccine. As weird as it sounds, it looks like the last ingredient we need to make the vaccine effective is a casus vitreus cluster. We now think that the vaccine recipe is complete, and we are preparing for the next phase of testing, which will involve administering the vaccine to infected subjects to evaluate its efficacy and safety. We are optimistic that this vaccine will be a crucial tool in our fight against the infection and will help us save countless lives.
